```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(qs)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
source(here("R", "plotting.R"))

combined_final <- qread(here("data", "derived", "visium_scored.qs"))
epithelial <- qread(here("data", "derived", "epithelial_diffusion_map.qs"))
figure_dir <- here("results", "figures", "supplementary")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# All sections and pathology annotations

```{r all-sections}
sample_order <- read_csv(here("config", "sample_manifest.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(include) |>
  pull(sample_id)

s1_clusters <- plot_spatial_samples(
  combined_final,
  group_by = "combined_cluster",
  samples = sample_order,
  colors = cluster_colors,
  ncol = 5,
  point_size = 1.3
)
s1_pathology <- plot_spatial_samples(
  combined_final,
  group_by = "Adenoma",
  samples = sample_order,
  colors = region_colors,
  ncol = 5,
  point_size = 1.3
)
save_plot(s1_clusters, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_all_sections_clusters.pdf"), 16, 14)
save_plot(s1_pathology, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_all_sections_pathology.pdf"), 16, 14)
```

# Quality control and modality contributions

```{r qc}
qc <- combined_final@meta.data |>
  select(Sample_ID, nCount_Spatial, nFeature_Spatial, percent.mt, ADT_n_detected, ADT_isotype_fraction) |>
  pivot_longer(-Sample_ID, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")
s2 <- ggplot(qc, aes(Sample_ID, value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
save_plot(s2, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_QC.pdf"), 12, 9)
```

# Additional score, pseudotime, and deconvolution views

```{r score-features}
s3 <- FeaturePlot(
  combined_final,
  reduction = "wnn.umap",
  features = c("SenMayo", "IEX", "Stem_Signature", "Senepy", "CytoTRACE2_Score", "dpt_pseudotime"),
  ncol = 3,
  keep.scale = "feature"
) & theme_void()
save_plot(s3, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_scores_umap.pdf"), 11, 7)
```

```{r pseudotime-spatial}
s4 <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  combined_final,
  features = "dpt_pseudotime",
  images = sample_order,
  ncol = 5,
  keep.scale = "all"
)
save_plot(s4, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_pseudotime_all_sections.pdf"), 16, 14)
```

```{r cell2location}
cell_types <- intersect(
  c("Dysplastic_Stem_like", "Dysplastic_Senescent_like", "Dysplastic_Proliferating", "CD8.T", "Fibroblast"),
  colnames(combined_final@meta.data)
)
s5 <- FeaturePlot(combined_final, reduction = "wnn.umap", features = cell_types, ncol = 3) & theme_void()
save_plot(s5, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_cell2location.pdf"), 11, 7)
```

# Adenoma radial distance from the tract surface

```{r surface-distance}
stem_distance <- read_csv(here("results", "tables", "surface_distance_stemness.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
senescence_distance <- read_csv(here("results", "tables", "surface_distance_senescence.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
distance_colors <- c(
  Normal = unname(region_colors[["Normal"]]),
  Adenoma = unname(region_colors[["Low-grade"]])
)

p_stem <- ggplot(stem_distance, aes(distance_bin_um, mean_score, color = Adenoma)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_spots), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "gam",
    formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs"),
    se = TRUE,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = distance_colors) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr() +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from tract surface (micrometers)",
    y = "Mean stemness score per 100-micrometer bin",
    size = "N spots"
  )

p_senescence <- ggplot(senescence_distance, aes(distance_bin_um, mean_score, color = Adenoma)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_spots), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "gam",
    formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs"),
    se = TRUE,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = distance_colors) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr() +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from tract surface (micrometers)",
    y = "Mean senescence score per 100-micrometer bin",
    size = "N spots"
  )

s6 <- (p_senescence / p_stem) & coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 825))
save_plot(s6, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_surface_distance.pdf"), 4, 8)
```

```{r surface-distance-example}
surface_spots <- read_csv(
  here("results", "tables", "surface_distance_spots.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
distance_index <- match(colnames(combined_final), surface_spots$barcode)
combined_final$tract_surface_depth_um <- surface_spots$tract_surface_depth_um[distance_index]

surface_example <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  combined_final,
  features = "tract_surface_depth_um",
  images = c("R4_large_1", "R4_large_2")
)
save_plot(
  surface_example,
  file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_surface_distance_example.pdf"),
  6,
  4
)
```

# Independent public single-cell validation

```{r single-cell-validation}
validation <- qread(here("data", "derived", "single_cell_validation.qs"))
s7 <- imap(validation, function(object, cohort) {
  DimPlot(object, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE) +
    FeaturePlot(object, features = c("Senepy", "Stem_Signature", "GDF15"), ncol = 3) +
    plot_annotation(title = cohort)
}) |>
  wrap_plots(ncol = 1)
save_plot(s7, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_single_cell_validation.pdf"), 12, 10)
```

# Sample-level cluster comparisons

```{r cluster-comparisons}
cluster_summary <- combined_final@meta.data |>
  group_by(Sample_ID, combined_cluster) |>
  summarise(Senepy = median(Senepy, na.rm = TRUE), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 30, combined_cluster %in% c("2", "3", "4"))
s8 <- ggplot(cluster_summary, aes(combined_cluster, Senepy, group = Sample_ID, fill = combined_cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Per-sample median SenePy score")
save_plot(s8, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_cluster_senescence.pdf"), 5, 4)
```

# Supplementary Figure 7A: sample-level GDF15 validation

```{r gdf15-sample-validation-advancement}
combined_final_epi = subset(combined_final, idents = c(2,4))
meta_adv <- combined_final_epi@meta.data |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Barcode") |>
  dplyr::filter(
    combined_cluster %in% c("2", "4")
  )

gdf15_adv_sample <- FetchData(
  combined_final_epi,
  vars = c("GDF15", "Sample_ID", "LargeSmall", "combined_cluster")
) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Barcode") |>
  dplyr::filter(
    combined_cluster %in% c("2", "4"),
    !is.na(LargeSmall)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Sample_ID, LargeSmall) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_GDF15 = mean(GDF15, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_GDF15 = median(GDF15, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_spots = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gdf15_adv_sample <- gdf15_adv_sample |>
  mutate(
    LargeSmall = factor(LargeSmall, levels = c("Small", "Large"))
  )

gdf15_adv_test <- wilcox.test(
  mean_GDF15 ~ LargeSmall,
  data = gdf15_adv_sample,
  alternative = "two.sided",
  exact = FALSE
)

gdf15_adv_test
gdf15_adv_sample |>
  group_by(LargeSmall) |>
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    median_of_sample_means = median(mean_GDF15),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


gdf15_sample = ggpubr::ggboxplot(
  gdf15_adv_sample,
  x = "LargeSmall",
  y = "mean_GDF15",
  add = "point",
  width = 0.6,
  fill = "LargeSmall"
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = size_colors) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Sample_ID),
            alpha = 0.25) +
  ylab("Mean GDF15 expression") +
  xlab(NULL)
gdf15_sample


```


```{r gdf15-sample-validation-stemness}

combined_final_epi@meta.data <- combined_final_epi@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column("Barcodes") %>%
  # dplyr::group_by(Sample_ID) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    q25 = quantile(Stem_Signature, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(Stem_Signature, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    StemGroup = dplyr::case_when(
      Stem_Signature <= q25 ~ "Low",
      Stem_Signature >= q75 ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ "Mid"
    )
  ) %>%
  # dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  column_to_rownames("Barcodes")

gdf15_stem_sample <- FetchData(
  combined_final_epi,
  vars = c("GDF15", "Sample_ID", "StemGroup")
) |>
  filter(StemGroup %in% c("High", "Low")) |>
  group_by(Sample_ID, StemGroup) |>
  summarise(
    mean_GDF15 = mean(GDF15, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = StemGroup,
    values_from = mean_GDF15
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(High), !is.na(Low))

gdf15_stemtest = wilcox.test(
  gdf15_stem_sample$High,
  gdf15_stem_sample$Low,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)
gdf15_stemtest
gdf15_stem_sample |>
  summarise(
    n_paired_samples = n(),
    median_high = median(High),
    median_low = median(Low),
    median_paired_difference = median(High-Low)
  )

gdf15_stem = ggpubr::ggboxplot(
  gdf15_stem_sample %>% pivot_longer(cols = c("High","Low"),names_to = "Stem_group",values_to = "GDF15") %>%
    mutate(Stem_group = factor(Stem_group,levels = c("Low","High"))),
  x = "Stem_group",
  y = "GDF15",
  add = "point",
  width = 0.6,
  fill = "Stem_group"
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Low = "#0652DD", High = "#ff5252")) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Sample_ID),
            alpha = 0.25) +
  ylab("Mean GDF15 expression") +
  xlab(NULL)
gdf15_stem
```



```{r gdf15-sample-validation-senescence}
combined_final_epi = subset(combined_final, subset = Adenoma != "Stroma")

combined_final_epi@meta.data <- combined_final_epi@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column("Barcodes") %>%
  # dplyr::group_by(Sample_ID) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cut_senepy = mean(Senepy) + 2*sd(Senepy),
    Senepy_pos = dplyr::case_when(
      Senepy <= cut_senepy ~ "No",
      Senepy > cut_senepy ~ "Yes"
    )
  ) %>%
  # dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  column_to_rownames("Barcodes")


gdf15_sene_sample <- FetchData(
  combined_final_epi,
  vars = c("GDF15", "Sample_ID", "Adenoma", "Senepy_pos")
) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Barcode") |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Senepy_pos == "Yes",
    Adenoma %in% c("Low-grade", "Normal")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Sample_ID, Adenoma) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_GDF15 = mean(GDF15, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_GDF15 = median(GDF15, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_spots = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Adenoma,
    values_from = c(mean_GDF15, median_GDF15, n_spots)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(`mean_GDF15_Low-grade`),
    !is.na(mean_GDF15_Normal)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    difference = `mean_GDF15_Low-grade` - mean_GDF15_Normal
  )

gdf15_sene_test <- wilcox.test(
  gdf15_sene_sample$`mean_GDF15_Low-grade`,
  gdf15_sene_sample$mean_GDF15_Normal,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided",
  exact = FALSE
)

gdf15_sene_test

gdf15_sene_sample |>
  summarise(
    n_paired_samples = n(),
    median_adenoma = median(`mean_GDF15_Low-grade`),
    median_normal = median(mean_GDF15_Normal),
    median_paired_difference = median(difference)
  )

gdf15_sen = ggpubr::ggboxplot(
  gdf15_sene_sample %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(`mean_GDF15_Low-grade`,"mean_GDF15_Normal"),names_to = "Sene_group",values_to = "GDF15") %>%
    mutate(Sene_group = factor(Sene_group,levels = c("mean_GDF15_Normal","mean_GDF15_Low-grade"))),
  x = "Sene_group",
  y = "GDF15",
  add = "point",
  width = 0.6,
  fill = "Sene_group"
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(mean_GDF15_Normal = "#0652DD", `mean_GDF15_Low-grade` = "#ff5252")) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Sample_ID),
            alpha = 0.25) +
  ylab("Mean GDF15 expression") +
  xlab(NULL)
gdf15_sen


```


```{r gdf15-sample-validation-summary}
gdf15_adv_test
gdf15_stemtest
gdf15_sene_test

save_plot(
  gdf15_sample + gdf15_stem + gdf15_sen,
  file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure7A_GDF15_sample_level_validation.pdf"),
  6,
  4
)
```
